hero.description: Computer Science & Mathematics graduate from the University of Granada. I automate infrastructure with Terraform and AWS, and build reproducible pipelines with Docker and CI/CD.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm an infrastructure and cloud engineer with a strong mathematical background, holding a double degree in Computer Science and Mathematics from the University of Granada. My work revolves around automation: infrastructure as code, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

I currently work hands-on with AWS (Lambda, RDS, EC2, IAM) and Terraform, building reproducible infrastructure end to end, while preparing for the AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification. My data engineering background (Spark, SQL, Microsoft Fabric) gives me a complete view of the data lifecycle and the infrastructure that supports it.

During my university years, I had the chance to do an Erasmus+ exchange at Politechnika Gdańska (Poland), where I deepened my knowledge in cryptography and algorithmics. That international experience shaped the way I work and think.

items.title: Electronic music & mixing

items.title: Illustration

items.title: Gaming
items.description: Gamer in my spare time. I especially enjoy games with solid progression systems and well-crafted narratives.

description: Developing Python and PowerShell automation scripts for workflow orchestration and deployment pipelines, reducing manual effort by 60%.
Building reproducible, containerized environments with Docker for consistent execution across development and production.
Designing modular, scalable data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric with automated validation, error handling, and performance monitoring in the regulated energy sector.
Worked with Spark, PySpark, Hive, and SQL for ETL processes and data analytics.
Contributed to scalable data solutions and data lake maintenance.
Collaborated with agile teams to deliver data-driven solutions for clients.
